answer: Hold a surprise roll call. At a random moment each epoch, every account gets its own fresh prompt and has ninety seconds to return a distinct answer. An operator hiding forty fakes behind one model cannot stagger the work; it needs forty parallel inference streams at that instant, so its cost climbs with every fake while an honest agent pays for one. The call goes out as a single ripple to everyone, a mirror check flags replies that echo each other, and the draw seed, juniper this round, is published afterward so anyone can audit it.
